topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation and outlines the lecture's objectives.

topics.label: Pathogen recognition and pattern recognition receptor signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system senses microbial infections and cellular damage through PAMPs, DAMPs, and various pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Sentinel cell activation, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the cellular events of acute inflammation, including sentinel cell activation, leukocyte extravasation into tissues, lymphatic drainage, and systemic complications like sepsis.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how acute inflammatory responses are resolved and describe the processes and outcomes of tissue repair, chronic inflammation, and granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the topic of the following lecture.
